_comment: Example body for POST /accounts/{account_id}/access/apps (Cloudflare API v4). A second self-hosted Access app that lets Claude reach the connector's public paths. Owner applies it by hand; jobwright never changes Access apps. Keep the main 'jobwright' app as it is: it still protects /oauth/authorize and everything else. Never add a plain /oauth path here. Verify field names against the current Access API before use.
name: jobwright connector (public paths)
